phase1_anchor.hypothesis: A sparse transform-domain code can reconstruct each section and preserve downstream behavior.
phase1_anchor.designed_method: VectorSAE with global TopK masking over cached ResNet-56 / CIFAR-100 activations.
phase1_anchor.designed_procedure: Train one SAE per section over fractions 2, 5, and 10 percent.
phase1_anchor.declared_success_criteria: Beat random and PCA baselines while staying within roughly 1 percentage point of original top-1.

phase1_random_baseline.hypothesis: The anchor result should not be reproducible with an untrained dictionary.
phase1_random_baseline.designed_method: Freeze a random SAE dictionary and evaluate the same splice metrics.
phase1_random_baseline.designed_procedure: Run selected random-baseline cells on the anchor sections.
phase1_random_baseline.declared_success_criteria: Random baseline should collapse toward chance.

phase1_pca_baseline.hypothesis: A learned sparse transform should outperform linear PCA at similar budget.
phase1_pca_baseline.designed_method: Per-section PCA over normalized cached activations.
phase1_pca_baseline.designed_procedure: Evaluate several ranks on the cached test activations.
phase1_pca_baseline.declared_success_criteria: PCA should underperform the learned SAE at matched-or-larger budget.

phase1_pareto.hypothesis: The FieldSAE winner has a clear retained-fraction knee and a persistent Q3 bottleneck.
phase1_pareto.designed_method: FieldSAE with global masking over fractions 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 12, and 20 percent.
phase1_pareto.designed_procedure: Sweep all sections on the same backbone with one final metric per cell.
phase1_pareto.declared_success_criteria: Recover monotone sparsity-fidelity curves and identify the operational sweet spot.

phase2_grid.hypothesis: An expressive FieldSAE should beat the VectorSAE, especially at aggressive sparsity and under RF-local masking.
phase2_grid.designed_method: Grid over Field versus Vector and Global versus RF masking.
phase2_grid.designed_procedure: Evaluate all planned section and budget combinations for the three surviving cells.
phase2_grid.declared_success_criteria: Identify a clear winner architecture for the hierarchy stages.

phase3_transitions.hypothesis: Sparse code at one section can generate the next section, and the frozen-block hybrid should upper-bound learned transitions.
phase3_transitions.designed_method: Train adjacent transition predictors between independent SAEs.
phase3_transitions.designed_procedure: Train four adjacent predictors and compare learned splice accuracy against the hybrid bound.
phase3_transitions.declared_success_criteria: Strong single-step transitions and an informative hybrid-vs-learned gap.

phase3_q3q4_strong_retry.hypothesis: The hard Q3 to Q4 step may yield to a larger predictor.
phase3_q3q4_strong_retry.designed_method: Retry the Q3 to Q4 transition with a deeper and wider predictor.
phase3_q3q4_strong_retry.designed_procedure: Train one focused retry for the bottleneck edge.
phase3_q3q4_strong_retry.declared_success_criteria: Close the gap between learned and hybrid Q3 to Q4 performance.

phase3b_chain.hypothesis: Scheduled sampling on re-grounded predicted inputs should stabilize the learned chain.
phase3b_chain.designed_method: Chain-aware training over the four adjacent predictors.
phase3b_chain.designed_procedure: Warm-start from Phase 3 and track chain metrics through training.
phase3b_chain.declared_success_criteria: Lift the re-grounded chain above the Family I baseline.

phase3b_bptt.hypothesis: Training through differentiable re-grounding should narrow the gap to the hybrid upper bound.
phase3b_bptt.designed_method: Full BPTT through the chain with in-graph re-grounding.
phase3b_bptt.designed_procedure: Repeat the chain-aware training with --bptt enabled.
phase3b_bptt.declared_success_criteria: Push the re-grounded chain closer to the hybrid chain than the original Phase 3b run.

phase2_rf_fair_changed.hypothesis: The earlier RF-local story may have been distorted by unfair budgeting.
phase2_rf_fair_changed.designed_method: Changed trainer with fair per-window RF fraction accounting.
phase2_rf_fair_changed.designed_procedure: Run all sections at 2, 5, and 10 percent.
phase2_rf_fair_changed.declared_success_criteria: Show whether RF-locality remains viable under fair budgeting.

phase3b_raw_only_changed.hypothesis: Raw chaining may be recoverable if the model is trained on its own rollout distribution.
phase3b_raw_only_changed.designed_method: Raw-carrier chain training with scheduled sampling, BPTT, and clipping.
phase3b_raw_only_changed.designed_procedure: Train one chain variant without re-grounding in the carrier path.
phase3b_raw_only_changed.declared_success_criteria: Move the raw chain well above chance.

phase1_patch_overlap_changed.hypothesis: The old VectorSAE baseline failed partly because it lacked local spatial context.
phase1_patch_overlap_changed.designed_method: Patchwise overlapping sparse coding with several patch multipliers.
phase1_patch_overlap_changed.designed_procedure: Sweep sections, fractions, and patch multipliers.
phase1_patch_overlap_changed.declared_success_criteria: Recover stronger low-budget performance than the pointwise vector baseline.

phase1_patch_depth_changed.hypothesis: Patch size should shrink with depth instead of staying uniformly large.
phase1_patch_depth_changed.designed_procedure: Sweep schedules a-d over sections and fractions.
phase1_patch_depth_changed.declared_success_criteria: Find a better schedule than uniform large patches.

phase1_patch_disjoint_changed.hypothesis: Disjoint tilings may behave differently from overlapping patch scans.
phase1_patch_disjoint_changed.designed_method: Disjoint patchwise sparse coding at a single retained fraction over several patch scales.
phase1_patch_disjoint_changed.designed_procedure: Run all sections at 5 percent for four patch multipliers.
phase1_patch_disjoint_changed.declared_success_criteria: Determine whether non-overlapping patches are competitive with overlap.

phase4_r20c10.hypothesis: The winner recipe should survive a smaller backbone and dataset shift.
phase4_r20c10.designed_method: FieldSAE with global masking on ResNet-20 / CIFAR-10.
phase4_r20c10.designed_procedure: Run all sections at 2, 5, and 10 percent.
phase4_r20c10.declared_success_criteria: Preserve near-original top-1 across sections on the new backbone/dataset.

phase4_seeds.hypothesis: The winner story should not be a single-seed accident.
phase4_seeds.designed_method: Repeat the winner SAE setup across seeds 0, 1, and 2.
phase4_seeds.designed_procedure: Train all five sections at 5 percent across the three seeds.
phase4_seeds.declared_success_criteria: Low enough variance that the qualitative story survives.

phase4_taxonomy.hypothesis: Sparse code is the strongest transition carrier among sparse, dense, and cross alternatives.
phase4_taxonomy.designed_method: Controlled Q4 to Q5 comparison across three representation families.
phase4_taxonomy.designed_procedure: Measure downstream preservation, prediction agreement, and KL for each condition.
phase4_taxonomy.declared_success_criteria: Sparse should dominate the alternative carriers.

phase4_r110.hypothesis: The winner recipe should transfer to a deeper CNN.
phase4_r110.designed_method: FieldSAE global masking on ResNet-110 / CIFAR-100 at 5 percent.
phase4_r110.declared_success_criteria: Preserve near-original accuracy and recover the same bottleneck pattern.

phase4_vit_transfer.hypothesis: The FieldSAE path should transfer to a ViT token grid.
phase4_vit_transfer.designed_method: FieldSAE over block-level ViT patch tokens on Imagenette.
phase4_vit_transfer.designed_procedure: Train on Imagenette train split and evaluate self-consistency on val.
phase4_vit_transfer.declared_success_criteria: High prediction agreement and low KL at sparse retained fraction.

tier1_intervention.hypothesis: Sparse parents should be causally important and spatially localized for their children.
tier1_intervention.designed_method: Importance and locality intervention metrics across adjacent transitions.
tier1_intervention.designed_procedure: Ablate top versus random parents and compare localized child responses.
tier1_intervention.declared_success_criteria: Large importance ratios and strong locality concentration.

tier2_feature_audit.hypothesis: The learned dictionary should be healthy rather than dead or duplicated.
tier2_feature_audit.designed_method: Audit dead features, duplicate features, and mean atom cosine.
tier2_feature_audit.designed_procedure: Run the audit on representative mid and deep sections.
